name: mupot
description: Mumega pot MCP for Cursor + Grok Bot — identity, inbox, send, and check-in. Not a chatbot host. The pot is the letter; this plugin is the install door.

MUPOT_TOKEN.title: Mupot member token
MUPOT_TOKEN.description: Agent-bound member bearer. Starts with mupot_. Shown once at mint (Connect card or mint_agent_token). Never commit it. Identity is this token → member_tokens.agent_id, not the Bot display name.

MUPOT_SEAT_LABEL.title: x-mupot-seat header
MUPOT_SEAT_LABEL.description: Optional. Value for the x-mupot-seat header (token label, e.g. grokbot-ceo-box). Cosmetic enrollment hint — not the inbox partition. Leave blank for a single door. For multiple doors, set this AND MUPOT_SEAT_QUERY.

MUPOT_SEAT_QUERY.title: MCP URL ?seat= uniquifier
MUPOT_SEAT_QUERY.description: Optional. URL query uniquifier (e.g. grokbot-ceo) because Cursor dedupes identical MCP URLs. Leave blank for a single door. For multiple doors, use a distinct slug per token.
